description: Reduced input template for scripts/compute_electroweak_c1_response.py after fixing the canonical gauge-factor basis and canonical no-finite-nonuniversal-counterterm scheme.

scheme_counterterm.reason: Finite non-universal counterterms are not selected data; canonical scheme sets them to zero rather than using them as adjustable threshold knobs.

basis_transport.reason: The response is defined directly in the selected (U1,SU2,SU3) basis, so no extra basis-transport vector is introduced.
